questionText: A grocer purchased 10 kg of rice for ₹700. He spends some amount on transportation and then sells it for ₹1,400. If the percentage of profit made by the grocer is 30%, then what is the amount (in ₹) he spends on transportation? (Round off to the nearest integer)
On selling a wardrobe at ₹3,437, the value of gain is 75% more than the value of loss incurred on selling it at ₹3,338. In order to gain 50%, find the selling price (in ₹).
Jitesh sold an article at a loss of 11%. If he had bought the item at 5% less and had sold it for ₹739 more, then he would have gained 20%. Find the cost price (in ₹) of the article.
solutionText:
Fast approach for exam (30 sec method):

Loss% se SP1 % nikal lo → 100 – 11 = 89%
New CP = 100 – 5 = 95%
Gain% new CP pe lagao → 95 × 1.20 = 114%
Difference = 114 – 89 = 25%
25% = 739 → CP (100%) = 739/25 × 100 = ₹2956
